recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. No further core FHIR action is needed for FHIR-37841 unless a work group separately revisits the deprecated topic element or the older Publishable logical pattern outside this MetadataResource reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-37841 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that MetadataResource.topic descriptions state that topics provide high-level categorization as well as keywords for filtering and searching, noting that vocabulary metadata resources already had the change and other metadata resources should match.
initial_application: The explicit application commit 44fbd855db updated source/metadataresource/structuredefinition-MetadataResource.xml only. Later FHIR-40406 alignment carried the keyword wording into source/definition/definition-spreadsheet.xml, but active ActivityDefinition, EventDefinition, Library, and PlanDefinition topic overrides still used older wording limited to topical categorization/search.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists MetadataResource as an active interface and the four edited artifacts as active resources. FHIR-38841 later deprecated MetadataResource.topic and added useContext migration guidance to topic comments, so this reconciliation preserved those later deprecation comments and changed only definition and requirements text. CodeSystem, ValueSet, NamingSystem, and ConceptMap already had the keyword wording.
reconciliation: Updated source/activitydefinition/structuredefinition-ActivityDefinition.xml, source/eventdefinition/structuredefinition-EventDefinition.xml, source/library/structuredefinition-Library.xml, and source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml so topic definitions mention keywords and requirements mention topical and keyword searches.
